selection_protocol: Reference availability, provider attributes, landscape variety, dated aerial spot checks and matched-scene preflight before any inference. No post-score replacement.
coverage_protocol: Fixed union of selected whole reference footprints. Whole predictions selected by representative point; boundary tolerance lengths use original lines inside mask. Precision is conditional on mapped coverage, not landscape-wide false positives.
